subject: method to convert a matrix to a vector array?

messages.author: a91fabdbaa0d03e2
messages.subject: method to convert a matrix to a vector array?
parts:
I have a parameter:

matrix[K,J] beta;

which I would like to convert to a vector array:

vector[K] beta_vectorized[J];

I couldn't find a built in Stan method to do this. Since this is a very simple conversion, is there a particular reason why such a method doesn't exist?

Best,

Michael

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] method to convert a matrix to a vector array?
parts:
Only because there are dozens and dozens of these simple
conversions when you play out all the combinatorics. For
instance, this one goes between matrix and vector/array and
tosses in a transpose.

I'd suggest just writing the converter as a function in Stan.

If anything, we'd support comformable assignment, but this one
needs a transpose because

beta_vectorized[j, k] == beta[k, j].

So it won't be fast for big matrices because of the
lack of memory locality. But it's probably an insignificant
cost compared to all the gradient calculations.

- Bob
